description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Compares 2 or 3 supplier offers for the buyer: whether they are comparable, total price as stated, what is included, what is missing or unclear, extra and hidden costs, risks, a criterion-by-criterion comparison and questions to send to each supplier before deciding. Numbers are copied exactly from the offers, never invented. Pass the text of each offer (extract text from PDFs first). The texts are processed for this answer only and are not stored by KULIC Advisory.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

offers.description: The offer texts, one string per offer, labelled A, B, C in this order.

what_is_bought.description: Optional: what is being bought, in one sentence.

name: compare_offers
title: Compare two or three supplier offers like a buyer (AICTIONBOT™ offer comparison)
